name: Prima Scriptura
description: While the Holy Scripture has to be considered the central source of salvation, it can not be considered the only source of divine revelation.

name: The Five Doors
description: Some among our people practice a meditation style consisting in closing all the doors in a house while opening the #italic five doors#! or the five senses. We will introduce this practice everywhere.

name: Holy Cooperation
description: A shift will occur towards promoting and actively participating in productive work. This ethos will extend to our agricultural communities, inspired by the early Christians' model of a sacred cooperative community.

name: The Twelve Emissaries
description: Inspired by the organization of some communities, we will elect among our elders and perfect ones twelve wise men to act as a supreme council, without creating a true hierarchy.

name: Arminianism
description: Arminianism is based on the pluralistic and humanitarian ideas of the Dutch Reformed theologian Jacobus Arminius.

name: Gomarism
description: Franciscus Gomarus opposes the beliefs of Jacobus Arminius who taught Pelagian doctrines and tried to create a new school of theology within the university where the two of them taught.

name: Institutionalized $arminianism$
description: $arminianism_desc$ This religious movement is now institutionalized within our state.

name: Institutionalized $gomarism$
description: $gomarism_desc$ This religious movement is now institutionalized within our state.

name: Consolamentum
description: As the process of living incurs, inevitably, in regret for our sins, the need to receive a consolation to enter Heaven pure and move closer to God becomes obvious. By receiving the #italic Consolamentum#!, our people are absolved of their sins upon impending death,

name: Pescatarianism
description: Animals are carriers of reincarnated souls, and because of that we cannot eat them. Fishes, beings spontaneously generated, cannot be considered animals and can be eaten.

name: The Perfects
description: Those among us that are specially commited to God and the virtues all human should pursue are called Perfects. These men and women receive #italic Consolamentum#! for their devotion and become Perfects. Contrary to regular folks, Perfects receive #italic Consolamentum#! twice in their lifes: when they are elevated to their new role and before dying.

name: Adoptionism
description: Our belief posits that Jesus Christ became God's Son at his baptism or resurrection, rather than being eternally divine.

name: Adult Baptism
description: Being baptized as an adult on the basis of profession of faith in Jesus Christ and as admission into a local community of faith is made by those who believe that saving grace and Church membership are gifts from God. The recipient's faith must be vocalized and cannot be imparted or transferred from one person to another.

name: Aniconism
description: Symbols are not a proper way to represent our Lord, as they are means to represent idols or people. We will reject any representation, including the cross used by other Christians.

name: Asceticism
description: Materialistic pursuits blind us to the divine truth. Only by devoting ourselves to live simple lives without luxury can we achieve spiritual enlightenment.

name: Bread and Wine
description: We believe that only a communion which includes both bread and wine is valid, even for lay members. Our clergymen will administer the communion under both kinds to every member of the service.

name: Clerical Poverty
description: The Clergy should own no riches and give up their material possessions. They should devote their attention to God rather than the secular world.

name: Crown as Head of Faith
description: The Church is no longer subject to one external, corrupt theocrat. Instead, all religious issues shall be now redirected to the ruler who serves as the new Head of the Faith.

name: Freedom to Preach
description: There is much disagreement among the followers, but each sect shall be given the freedom to preach freely so long as God is in their hearts.

name: Gnosticism
description: Gnosticism centers on personal salvation through #italic gnosis#!. We will escape the material world and return to a higher realm by seeking spiritual insight.

name: Individual Creeds
description: Allowing our people to formulate their own creeds will encourage the formation of individual opinions and allow to pave the way for the path to progress!

name: Monasticism
description: The pleasures of fine food and drink only serve to distract us from service to the divine. Isolating ourselves in remote monasteries is the best way to avoid these temptations.

name: Modalism
description: We believe that God is absolutely one, and the trinitarian concepts like the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit are merely different modes in which God manifests Himself.

name: Appointment of Bishops
description: Instead of discarding the appointment of bishops entirely, they will serve the Church as the administrators of larger areas.

name: Pacifism
description: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God.

name: Parish Registers
description: Details of baptisms, marriages, and burials will from now on be documented in a parish register. Each parish priest will keep a book where they will enter these events and keep it in a sure coffer with two locks.

name: Participation of Women
description: While women do participate as equals in our communities, we will adopt a general rule everywhere so that they are treated as men are.

name: Rejection of Sacraments
description: Our doctrine rejects most Christian sacraments as they are mostly physical and are of no importance. The spiritual part is the only one that matters, to make us closer to God.

name: Sola Fide
description: No good deed can satisfy God. We are pardoned by the divine grace alone, which God has granted through His only Son, Jesus Christ.

name: Sola Scriptura
description: The Bible, the word of God delivered unto man, is the sole authority for Christian doctrine. All religious practices that cannot be supported by Biblical reference are to be denounced as heresy.

name: Soli Deo Gloria
description: All human achievements can only be created with the the praise of God as their dedication.

name: Translated Bibles
description: Translating Bibles to a language the people of our country speak gives them the best pathway to God in a way that speaks to their minds and hearts.

name: Usury Allowed
description: Monetary loans with interest that enrich the lender is now allowed and no longer considered sinful.

name: War Sermons
description: In times of conflicts, the faith preserves the hope of our people. The Church of our realm will preach from the Holy Book to keep the morale of the population up even during the darkest hours.

name: Olympic Games
description: The Olympic Games are a celebration of the gods and a demonstration of our country's strength and unity. Participation in the games is a civic duty that brings honor to our athletes.

name: Heroic Cults
description: Our history is full of powerful figures who shaped our society and our character. These were the mortal sons of the gods, humans with extraordinary abilities who often met tragic fates, and who protected and led our ancestors into founding the great nation that we are today. It is now our duty to worship them and learn their lessons.

name: Dionysian Mysteries
description: The rituals, dance, and music of those initiated into the mysteries of Dionysus provide liberation and release to its members, without distinction of social classes. The death and rebirth of the god are mirrored by the cycle of the grape vine, growing from the earth, becoming wine, and finally being drunk by the acolytes in glory of Dionysus.

name: Eleusinian Mysteries
description: The acolytes of the Eleusinian mysteries follow the myth of the abduction of Persephone from her mother, Demeter, by the king of the underworld, Hades, and her subsequent release and deception. To the initiated, this myth represents the cycle of growth and rebirth of all plant life and the eternity of life as it flows from one generation to the next.

name: Samothracian Mysteries
description: On the island of Samothrace, a mystery cult thrived during the height of Hellenism; it famously accepted anybody who wanted to join, no matter their social class. It is said that many mythological heroes, like Heracles, Jason, and Orpheus, were initiated at Samothrace. We can collect and reconstruct these mysteries from the remains and ruins, and bring this cult back to its former glory.

name: Civic Religion
description: Honoring the gods is the same as maintaining the well-being of the state. Therefore, religious practices and ceremonies are a civic duty that we must uphold to ensure the prosperity of our polis.

name: Mithraic Mysteries
description: The initiates in the Mithraic mysteries who call themselves Syndexioi enjoyed a great deal of popularity in Rome and the Western Roman Empire during the height of the Empire. Their rituals, gatherings, and feasts took place in secret underground temples, but we can bring them back to the light, and revive their traditions for the benefit of our people.

name: Imperial Cult
description: As the ancient emperors of Rome were once regarded as divine by the people and Senate, our ruler and their dynasty are also to be considered as such. Their greatness, majesty, and authority clearly mark them as not only divinely sanctioned, but as gods themselves.

name: Dii Familiares
description: The domestic and familiar gods play a very important role for the people of our country. They protect and influence everything that happens in a person's domain, which commonly entails a household, but could also encompass roadways, neighborhoods, or even entire cities.

name: Mos Maiorum
description: The unwritten code that ruled the lives of Romans from antiquity to the height of the Empire, the 'Way of the Ancestors.' This set of traditions and practices has defined what it means to be a Roman and how to behave both inside the household and in public.

name: Monism
description: The philosophers of our revival hold that all existence flows from The One — a single transcendent principle from which all gods and all things emanate. The traditional pantheon becomes allegory; the gods are aspects of The One. Omens lose their particular force, but faith in The One suffuses every act of governance.

name: Adamite Services
description: The Adamite sect insists upon nakedness during church services. Without the stylings of status or culture, we appear as equals in the eyes of God, a stark reminder of our shared humanity and of the innocence we enjoyed before the Fall.

name: Punishment of Sin
description: All who sin must be punished equally, no matter wealth or rank. Even the nobility are not above the laws of God.

name: Ritual Purification
description: Both the soul and the body of the faithful must be clean and free of impurities if they are to get closer to God.

name: Specialized Canon
description: Books inspired by God are all deserving to be revered and studied, even those of less spiritual quality that are outright rejected by other confessions.

name: Eastward Prayer
description: It is common practice in all Christendom to pray towards the East, to the rising sun of Christ. Some other confessions may be more loose with this orientation, but for us there is simply no other manner of praying, both in public and in private, and all our churches need to be accomodated to follow that orientation.

name: Baptism by Fire
description: Our faith does not believe that baptims by water is permanent, as Saint John the Baptist admited. It is only by touching the four sides of the head of a person with a burning candle that a permanent baptism can happen.

name: Name Change
description: The power of names is well known by our communities. Our faith leaders often change their names after the names of followers of Saint Paul, as common folks change the name of their settlements to those of places where our patron Saint dwelled.

name: Paulician Canon
description: Our people reject the Old Testament and its Prophets, as they reject the inclusion of the epistles of Saint Peter. Only the words of Saint Paul are appropriate.

name: Punishment by Stoning
description: Stoning is a common practice to punish religious dissidents among our communities that stand out from our neighbors. This is most likely an inheritance from our Anatolian origins.

name: Justified Conflicts
description: The new Church of the country is threatened by heathens and heretics alike. In a war of self-preservation, the Church will justify our conflicts with the Bible.

name: Pietism
description: Pietism focuses on the individual piety of every believer and emphasizes the inner transformation that leads to a devout Christian life.
